This '''[[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing]] assault group''' was under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Horton Salm/Legends|Horton Salm]] in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]]. Consisting of seventy-two craft, they were based off the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Moonshadow (Imperial II-class)|''Moonshadow'']], and participated in the [[Battle of Liinade III]].
